newsitem.title: GERMANY: Unions, Lufthansa to meet on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Unions, Lufthansa to meet on Monday.

text.p: German airline Lufthansa AG will meet trade unions on Monday for what could be the decisive round of wage talks, the DAG white collar trade union said on Sunday.
DAG said it would be joined by the OeTV public services and transport workers union to "attempt to reach a conclusion" of talks that have dragged on since October of last year.
OeTV last October struck a wage deal with Lufthansa that would remain in effect until March 1998. The deal included a wage increase of 1.7 percent and a profit-sharing package for employees.
But DAG refused to sign the agreement and has sought instead to renegotiate for an improved profit-sharing scheme.
After DAG two weeks accept the basic agreement from October, it is widely expected that the two sides will reach agreement soon.
Talks begin at 0700 GMT on Monday in Seeheim near Frankfurt.
